first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, with prior evidence of durable adoption gains. Promotional pricing is the strongest alternative given competitor pressure, but its effect on long-term customer quality and revenue durability should be verified before prioritizing it.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior test improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its verified 18% qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower retention and failure through the first renewal cycle.
